context: Request: which of the firm's M&A deals never made it to closing, including mergers that could not get regulatory clearance. Rubric: eight matters (1001-00005, 1002-00004, 1003-00001, 1011-00005, 1017-00007, 1018-00008, 1020-00006, 1032-00005) plus a precision criterion; other stalled or dormant deals (e.g. Northgate/Ridgeline in 1022-00002, Cascadia 1023-00001, Cascade Retail 1038-00001) are outside the permitted set.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Lists matter folders to a file and prints the first and last twenty.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Counts files by extension; a store-wide extraction script for outcome words times out with no output.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script, continued. find | grep over paths for deal and outcome words (3,081 hits, first 240 shown), then a grep of that list for termination words. Review: goal not reached, content scan never rerun.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Lists all files of ten candidate matters, opening reads of termination memos and letters, a path filter over every matter, one more folder listing and further reads; confirms three deals. Review: about 60 surfaced matters unopened.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: declared: Screen candidate matters by reading documents (attempt 2). find | grep over all paths for status, closing-memo and termination file names (272 hits).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: same stage, continued. Opening reads of termination and closing memos of six matters from that list, three folder listings and more reads; adds two deals.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads memos of two candidates it is weighing; excludes one and keeps a dormant deal.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes five deals that did not close. Review flags possible over-inclusion of a dormant deal that was never terminated.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Edits the conclusion into four terminated deals plus one dormant deal, re-reads it and checks paths.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: Its only content scan timed out and its file-name searches never reached one qualifying deal; of the qualifying matters its name searches did show, it opened three and the answer adds two stalled deals that do not qualify.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its only content scan timed out with no output and was never rerun; the file-name searches that replaced it never showed one qualifying deal, whose files carry no outcome words in their names.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [25] said the content scan was not rerun and that matters filed under other names would be missed, without naming one; no content search followed.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The name search just before ([22]-[23]) showed three more qualifying matters, but the ten matters it chose to list and read left them out and it never opened them.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [60] said only about ten of 70 surfaced matters were opened; it ran another name search and opened other matters.

other_errors.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
other_errors.why: The status-file search just before ([63]-[64]) showed another qualifying matter, but the matters it chose to read next left it out.
other_errors.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [84] listed unopened surfaced matters without naming this one.

other_errors.why: The answer asserts two stalled deals, one dormant and one with an indefinitely postponed auction (evidence seen at [65]-[94]), as deals that did not close, under matter numbers outside the qualifying set.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The write review named the dormant deal as a possible over-inclusion; the edit only set it apart within the answer.

runs.failure_point: Its broad name search showed all eight qualifying deals, but it narrowed to failure-word file names and a hand-picked scan set that left out three of them; the answer also keeps two stalled deals as dormant non-closings.

first_error.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
first_error.why: The name searches before it ([17], [23], [35]) showed three qualifying deals that it never scanned or read: the 18 matters it hand-picked for the in-matter scan, and all later reads, left them out.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [49] said only 18 hand-picked matters were scanned; it reran a store-wide tight scan whose counts did not show them, and never opened them.

other_errors.why: The answer counts two dormant deals with expired outside dates or no final disposition (evidence seen at [74]-[106]) among the deals that did not close.
other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [106] named both matters as resting on dormancy or outside-date memos, and the write review warned against counting stalled deals; it regrouped them as dormant but kept them.

divergence: All three runs failed the same way: the content scans timed out or were narrowed, candidates were chosen through file-name words (termination, withdrawal, status), and qualifying deals whose files carry no such words were never opened. T0 and T1 never surfaced one deal at all (search miss) and left out others their searches showed (surfaced, never opened); T2's broad name search showed all eight but its hand-picked scan set left out three. T0 and T2 also kept stalled or dormant deals as non-closings (over-inclusion) after reviews named them; T1 passed the precision criterion. Reviews flagged unopened matters generically in every run.
